programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Paskal Barbaro (Aleksandar Bertran) izlazi iz zatvora, ali tek kada razvije neprijateljstvo s članom grupe "Braća zauvek", Malim Ludakom (Rahel Roman). Les Elijas (Salvatore Koko) predlaže Barbaru da se poveže s Farhadom "Avganistanskim guruom" (Majkl Vajs), novim vođom grupe "Braća zauvek", koji mrzi Malog Ludaka, i da njihov sukob pretvori u sopstvenu korist.

programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Ljubav, luksuz i bogatstvo učvršćuju Rujin položaj na vrhu. Dok OneCoin osvaja svet, ona postaje međunarodna zvezda. Međutim, kako raste njena moć, umnožavaju se i neprijatelji. Optužbe za prevaru, izdaje iz najbližeg okruženja i sve veći pritisak prete da sruše carstvo koje je godinama pažljivo gradila.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: OneCoin odavno nije samo kriptovaluta, već pokret čiji je neprikosnoveni vođa Ruja Ignatova. Uverena u sopstvenu nepogrešivost, pokušava da zaključi ambiciozan posao sa uticajnim biznismenom Li Čanom u Hongkongu. Međutim, upravo će taj potez pokrenuti događaje koji će ugroziti sve što je izgradila.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Šta sve radimo za ljubav
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Šta učini, sine moj?
programme.desc: Inspirisan zločinom koji se dogodio, čovek počinje da doživljava stvari koje će ga navesti da mačem ubije rođenu majku.

programme.title: Sivi čovek
programme.desc: Ozloglašeni serijski ubica, Albert Fiš, majstor prijatne spoljašnosti, prikazan je u realističnom Njujorku dvadesetih godina prošlog veka, gde pronalazi lakoverne mlade žrtve i pothranjuje sopstvenu izopačenost. Perspektivnom detektivu dodeljen je slučaj nedavno nestalog deteta, dvanaestogodišnje Grejs Bad.

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Kralj boraca

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri

Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

He instead becomes involved with the flirtatious Tomiko, who is also conducting an affair with Michiko's husband. When Michiko finds that her husband has abandoned her, she decides to take her fate into her own hands.

programme.title: The Big Wheel

The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Paper wasn't always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Disasters in the air and misfortunes at sea grab our attention because of the unusually large number of fatalities involved. But it's not even necessary to leave dry land for a terrible disaster to happen. Rail journeys and even just getting in your car can be fraught with disaster. That's the focus for this instalment of Desperate Hours _ road and rail disasters. We will examine the causes of such accidents, be that the powers of nature or human folly. We are about to explore the worst of the worst destructive events from an ordinary day on Nigerian roads to a disastrous display of human error in Santiago de Compostella when the driver of a loaded passenger train went about 115 km/h over the established speed limit and drove his train straight into a wall. So buckle up; you're in for a bumpy ride…

programme.title: RV Explorers

programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or "chumming" _ attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther _ carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Their bodies have long turned to dust, but the spirits of the original owners who built Bellewood remain in charge and don't mind chasing out tresspassers.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped _ the stellar sea lion To help understand why their numbers are dropping, researchers work with the highly intelligent mammals at a unique floating laboratory. At The Open Water Research Station, free swimming seals and sea lions are observed in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let's face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don't know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don't know much _ and certainly not nearly enough _ about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it's little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: This angry spirit doesn't like being dead and still considers himself the sole owner of lovely Oaklands Mansion.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bonjour! We're headed to Quebec Province on today's show. First, we get blown away by the thunderous pipes at Montreal's Notre Dame Basilica. After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of a mountain bike action movie with the top riders in the world hitting new stunts and tricks that will elevate the sport of freeride mountain biking.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A team of surfers and kayakers have gathered together in Costa Rica to search out world-class surf breaks, remote rivers and virgin waterfalls.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein's theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.desc: Džejmi i Džimi ugošćavaju britanskog glumca Martina Frimena, koji im se pridružuje na pristaništu u kulinarskoj avanturi života. Džejmi pomaže zvezdi serijala "Šerlok" da otkrije tajne pripremanja savršenih benediktanskih jaja.

programme.title: Donalova avantura kroz Irsku
programme.desc: Donal Skijan i njegov pas Maks putuju na zapad, u potrazi za prelepim pejzažima, mirom i ukusnom hranom Golveja. Donal bolje upoznaje konemara ponije i uči tradicionalni ples "Sean Nós". Zatim, trajektom putuje do ostrva "Inis Mór", gde jaše konja.

programme.title: Donalova avantura kroz Irsku
programme.desc: Donal i njegov verni ovčar Maks putuju do istočne obale Irske, u zemlju kristala, vikinga i joge za pse, okruga Voterford. Ovaj okrug je bogat prelepim primorskim selima i neverovatnim plažama, i proglašen je za najbolje mesto za život u Irskoj.

programme.title: Eva Pau: Azijska kuhinja

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Dve vrste ribe, pasulj i svež čeri paradajz. Pitate se šta to može da ispadne od ove kombinacije? Rešenje je neverovatna salata od pasulja. Lora i Stojan je obožavaju jer je drugačija, zasitna i neverovatno zanimljiva.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Lora i Stojan podsetiće gledaoce čemu to francuska kuhinja duguje svetsku popularnost. Prvo će pripremiti poznatu lionsku salatu, sačinjenu od tri osnovna sastojka, ali izuzetno ukusnu. Spremiće i frikasu od zečetine.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Današnji recepti Lore i Stojana su bez mesa. Međutim, zbog nedostatka mesa, jela neće biti oštećena, naprotiv. Čorba od pečenih crvenih paprika, peršuna i pečenog belog luka prepuna je ukusnih aroma. Dvojac će potom spremiti sicilijansku kapanotu.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Tarator, musaka, pečene jabuke, ovo je pravi knjiški meni. Kako će Lora i Stojan spremiti jela koja predstavljaju srce bugarske kuhinje? Taratar će biti drugačiji, sa rotkvicama, hladnom i veoma ukusnom zelenom salatom. Musaku će uviti u lisnato testo.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Šta su Lora i Stojan isplanirali da skuvaju u ovoj epizodi? Njihova omiljena pileća džigerica biće kombinovana sa ukusnom i bogatom salatom. To je impresivno predjelo za goste. Ono što sledi jednako je zadivljujuće, svinjetina u plućnoj maramici.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan pokazaće nam zašto je dobra ideja imati zamrznuti grašak u frižideru, i kako od njega možemo da napravimo ukusnu, kremastu čorbu. Pokazaće nam i zanimljiv recept za zečetinu na lovački način.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Za predjelo, Lora i Stojan spremaju pečene patlidžane sa paradajzom i sirom. Pokazaće i kako palenta može da postane ukusno glavno jelo. Njihov recept za braon palentu sa hrskavom kobasicom i braon puterom je zanimljiv.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Brusketi sa pasuljem i tunjevinom, koje u ovoj epizodi spremaju Lora i Stojan, veoma su ukusni i brzo se pripremaju. Kuvari će spremati giros sa svinjetinom i paprikom. To je zanimljiv recept koji je pogodan za goste.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Provansa, jednostavno
programme.desc: Kuvar Markus Vering u Provansi otkriva tajne najbolje i najjednostavnije francuske hrane. On će kuvati jednostavna ukusna jela i deliti savete i trikove koji će vam pomoći da stvorite ukus Provanse kod kuće.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Provansa, jednostavno
programme.desc: Kuvar Markus Vering u Provansi otkriva tajne najbolje i najjednostavnije francuske hrane. On će kuvati jednostavna ukusna jela i deliti savete i trikove koji će vam pomoći da stvorite ukus Provanse kod kuće.

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Nakon čitavog dana u kom se istok i zapad susreću u Hongkongu, Niki ima neugodno blizak susret sa zmijom. Kod kuće, Niki priprema batake od pet kineskih začina, knedle sa šampinjonima i slatke knedle.

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Oahaka je poznata kao jedna od najboljih kulinarskih destinacija na svetu. Nakon nekoliko neobičnih zalogaja na pijaci, Niki odlazi u mlin za čokoladu i zatim odlazi u posetu starosedelačkoj porodici, da bi naučila da pravi tamale.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi pokazuje kako se pravi azijski losos, čorba od nudli, salata od pasulja i dezert od azijskih trešanja za manje od pola sata.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi pravi ukusnu piletinu sa pirinčom i pasuljem, svežom naseckanom salatom i kukuruzom pečenim na roštilju. Sve to za samo 30 minuta.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan predstavljaju zanimljive recepte i korisne savete za različite prilike.

programme.title: Ostrvski zalogaji sa hebridskim pekarom

programme.title: Ukusi Italije

programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje kulinarske užitke pravog mediteranskog dragulja, Majorke, koja je raj za ljubitelje hrane sa neverovatnim proizvodima, pijacama, restoranima i barovima. Markus slavi najbolje što Majorka nudi u ovoj ukusnoj novoj seriji.

programme.title: Markus na Mediteranu: Majorka

programme.title: Ukusi 2 generacije

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Niki istražuje bujne pejzaže juga Indije. Obilazeći pijace začina, vijugave reke i porodične kuhinje, Niki otkriva tajne kako, kod kuće, napraviti odličan kari.

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Niki uživa u zalogajima Osake, koja je poznata kao kulinarski centar Japana. Kod kuće, Niki priprema "karaage" piletinu, udon nudle i sladoled od zelenog čaja.

programme.title: Ostrvski zalogaji sa hebridskim pekarom
programme.desc: Najprodavaniji autor kuvara, Koinjah Maklaud, poznat kao "Hebridski Pekar", prikazuje kulinarske i kulturne pejzaže Farskih ostrva, Bornholma (Danska), Lofota (Norveška) i Gotlanda (Švedska), od kuhinja sa Mišlenovim zvezdicama do porodičnih farmi.

programme.title: Indija: Luk Nuen
programme.desc: Luk počinje svoju avanturu u Bangaloru. On odlazi u samo srce grada, u kafić MTR, zatim usavršava tehniku pripreme jela idli i uživa u atmosferi i ukusima noćnih pijaca u muslimanskoj četvrti.

programme.title: Indija: Luk Nuen
programme.desc: U muslimanskoj četvrti u Bangaloru, Luk otkriva tajne pripreme neverovatnog birjanija u jednom neobičnom restoranu i jede jedan neverovatan tifin u restoranu "Brahmin's Coffee House Bar".

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Godišnja doba
programme.desc: Džejmi Oliver nas vodi od proleća do zime slaveći prelepe sastojke i ukusna jela, zagovarajući sezonsku ishranu i naglašavajući sastojke svojim receptima koji još i pomažu planeti. Ovo je slavlje održivih proizvoda i načina na koji ih kuvamo.

programme.title: Loši momci
programme.desc: Markus Barnet je porodični čovek i papučar. Majk Louri je slobodan i razuzdan zavodnik. Obojica su policajci iz Majamija i imaju 72 sata da povrate pošiljku droge ukradenu odmah ispred njihove stanice. Da stvar bude gora, kako bi pridobili jedinog svedoka ubistva, njih dvojica moraju zameniti uloge: Markus postaje Majk, Majk postaje Markus.

programme.title: Londonski bulevar
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom usamljenom glumicom.

programme.title: Igra stotinu sveća
programme.desc: Grupa prijatelja okuplja se kako bi učestvovala u tajanstvenoj igri, od koje svako očekuje nešto zauzvrat. Pravilo igre je da se uz svaku zapaljenu sveću mora ispričati jedna horor priča.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Mala sirena
programme.desc: Mladi novinar i njegova sestričina otkrivaju prelepo i očaravajuće stvorenje za koje veruju da je prava mala sirena.

programme.title: Dve karte za Mars
programme.desc: Glavni protagonista traži pomoć osiguravajuće kuće kako bi isplanirao put u jednom pravcu za Mars.

programme.title: Mister Olimpija
programme.desc: Inspirativna priča o začetnicima fitnesa kakvog danas poznajemo, Džou i Benu Vajderu. Suočeni s antisemitizmom i velikim siromaštvom, braća su savladala sve prepreke, izgradila imperiju i inspirisala buduće generacije.

programme.title: Ponovo pisati
programme.desc: Oskarom nagrađeni pisac, koji je zapao u krizu, napušta Holivud i odlazi na Istočnu obalu da predaje pisanje scenarija na fakultetu. Tu se zaljubljuje u samohranu majku, studentkinju tog fakulteta.

programme.title: Svi putevi vode u Rim
programme.desc: Megi je samohrana majka i fakultetska profesorka iz Njujorka. U pokušaju da pronađe zajednički jezik sa Samer, njenom ćerkom tinejdžerkom, Megi odlazi u selo u Toskani, gde je kao mlada provela mnogo vremena. Odmah po dolasku Megi nailazi na Luku, zgodnog bivšeg momka koji je i dalje neženja i živi sa svojom osamdesetogodišnjom majkom, Karmen. Samer, kojoj nedostaje žestoki momak iz Njujorka, zajedno s Karmen, koja uprkos Lukinom protivljenju planira da se uda za Marselina, njenu jedinu pravu ljubav, impulsivno kradu Luki kola i beže u Rim. Megi i Luka kreću u poteru za njima.

programme.title: Reči
programme.desc: Mladi pisac Rori Jansen koji je na vrhuncu svog književnog uspeha, otkriva visoku cenu koju mora da plati za krađu tuđeg dela.

programme.title: Uzbunjivačica
programme.desc: Viner je briljantna mlada buntovnica iz Teksasa čiji se moral dovodi u pitanje tokom službe u Vazduhoplovstvu SAD i rada za NSA. Ova priča o odrastanju prati devojku progonjenu zbog njenih ideala i istrajavanja u principima.

programme.title: Na prvu loptu
programme.desc: Kada kompulsivni kockar ne može da vrati dug svom prijatelju, dobija mogućnost da dug otplati tako što će trenirati bejzbol tim iz centra grada. Prihvatanje ovog izazova donosi nove poglede na život njemu, ali i deci u timu. Zasnovano na knjizi "Hardball: A Season in the Projects" Danijela Kojla.

programme.title: Stražar
programme.desc: Iskompromitovan nakon afere s prvom damom, iskusni agent tajne službe biva optužen da planira atentat na predsednika. Sada je primoran da se za pomoć obrati neprijateljski nastrojenom bivšem štićeniku kako bi otkrio pravog krivca.

programme.title: Klub mladih milijardera
programme.desc: Grupa imućnih momaka u Los Anđelesu tokom ranih osamdesetih godina, pravi plan za brzo bogaćenje koji se pretvara u smrtonosnu igru.

programme.title: Dnevnik opijanja
programme.desc: Krajem pedesetih godina prošlog veka, neuspeli pisac postaje radnik propalog časopisa u Portoriku, gde upada u kandže alkohola, postaje deo sumnjive šeme za eksploataciju zemljišta i zaljubljuje se u prelepu, ali verenu ženu.

programme.title: Dnevnik opijanja

programme.title: Loši momci 2
programme.desc: Detektivi Markus Barnet i Majk Louri iz jedinice za narkotike u Majamiju dobijaju zadatak da zaustave dotok ekstazija u grad. Trag ih vodi do poremećenog kubanskog narko-bosa Džonija Tapije, koji je usput u krvavom ratu s ruskom i haićanskom mafijom. Kao da to nije dovoljno, među partnerima dolazi do tenzije kada Markus otkrije da zavodnik Majk krišom izlazi s njegovom sestrom, Sid.

programme.title: Kritičko razmišljanje
programme.desc: Istinita priča o šahovskom timu srednje škole Majami Džekson, prvom gradskom timu koji je osvojio nacionalno šahovsko prvenstvo Sjedinjenih Američkih Država.

programme.title: Tajna zmajevog pečata
programme.desc: Engleski putnik Džonatan Grin dobija od Petra Velikog nalog da mapira ruski Daleki istok. Još jednom kreće na dugo putovanje ispunjeno neverovatnim avanturama koje će ga konačno odvesti do Kine. Kartograf će neočekivano naići na mnoštvo izvanrednih otkrića, susresti bizarna stvorenja, upoznati se s kineskim princezama i suočiti sa opasnim majstorima borilačkih veština, pa čak i sa kraljem svih zmajeva.

programme.title: Intergalaktičke avanture Maksa Klauda
programme.desc: Svemirska krstarica pada na ljubičastu planetu Hinus, intergalaktički zatvor u kom borave najopasniji i najveći zločinci u galaksiji.

programme.title: Peščani čovek
programme.desc: Jednog jutra, Beno pronalazi pesak u svom krevetu. Iako u početku pokušava ovo da ignoriše, ubrzo shvata da taj pesak ispada iz njega. Iz dana u dan, količina peska je sve veća i njegovo vreme ubrzano ističe. Na kraju nema izbora i pomoć traži od Sandre, vlasnice omanjeg kafea ispod njegovog stana. Iako je Beno strastveno mrzi, počinje da je sanja svake noći. Kakva je veza između Sandre, snova i peska?

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Crveno nebo
programme.desc: Osramoćeni "top gan" pilot, Buč Masters, predvodi odmetnuti vod koji mora da povrati kataklizmičko oružje za masovno uništenje. Kad otkrije da njegov bivši partner, Tom Kreg, radi za teroriste, Masters se mora izboriti s uništenim prijateljstvom i ljubavnim trouglom, ali i upustiti u vazdušnu bitku, kako bi povratio vojničku i ličnu čast.

programme.title: Krvoproliće
programme.desc: Priča o srdačnom susretu četvoro roditelja, nakon tuče u školskom dvorištu između njihovih sinova.

programme.title: Priča o Džejn Ostin
programme.desc: Biografski portret mlade Džejn Ostin pre slave i romanse s mladim Ircem.

programme.title: Kancelarija na ćošku
programme.desc: U ovoj komediji o kancelarijskom životu, savesni službenik Orson pronalazi utočište u praznoj kancelariji, daleko od napornih kolega. Međutim, njegov neobičan izbor izaziva neočekivano negodovanje i pokreće niz apsurdnih događaja.

programme.title: Zavera
programme.desc: U bliskoj budućnosti savezna vlada unajmljuje grupu kriminalaca da zaustavi sajber napad koji bi mogao dovest do bankrota Sjedinjenih Američkih Država.

programme.title: Crno more
programme.desc: Kako bi se nagodio s bivšim poslodavcima, kapetan podmornice prihvata posao od tajanstvenog finansijera da pretraži dubine Crnog mora u potrazi za podmornicom za koju se priča da je prepuna zlata.

programme.title: Zajednički rat
programme.desc: U Drugom svetskom ratu, odred afroameričkih vojnika odlazi iza neprijateljskih linija u misiju spasavanja svog nestalog komandanta i oborenog pilota lovca.

programme.title: Loši momci zauvek
programme.desc: Markus i Majk su prinuđeni da se suoče s novim pretnjama, promenama u karijeri, ali i s krizom srednjih godina, kada se pridruže novoformiranom elitnom timu AMMO u okviru policije Majamija, kako bi srušili nemilosrdnog Armanda Armasa, surovog vođu lokalnog narko-kartela.

programme.title: Loši momci zauvek
programme.desc: Markus i Majk su prinuđeni da se suoče s novim pretnjama, promenama u karijeri, ali i s krizom srednjih godina, kada se pridruže novoformiranom elitnom timu AMMO u okviru policije Majamija, kako bi srušili nemilosrdnog Armanda Armasa, surovog vođu lokalnog narko-kartela.

programme.title: Na sprovodu
programme.desc: Kad sve krene naopako za neobičnu Karis Rajtman, ona radi ono što bi učinila svaka emotivno izolovana, moderna devojka. Počinje da posećuje sahrane nepoznatih ljudi. Na jednoj sudbonosnoj sahrani, upoznaje Tajlera, čoveka kome je umrla verenica. Uprkos upozorenjima grobara Šejna, njenog najboljeg prijatelja, kao i cimerke Lile, prvi put uspeva da ostvari nekakvu vezu. Tragajući za odgovorima, Karis odlazi kod svoje otuđene majke, kako bi se suočila s prošlošću.

programme.title: Buka u tami
programme.desc: Tokom operacije spasavanja VIP ličnosti sa ekskluzivnog ostrva, elitni tim upada u smrtonosnu klopku. Akcija se pretvara u borbu za opstanak pred zlokobnom silom koja ih nemilosrdno progoni.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Kung-fu kaskader
programme.desc: Propali kaskader i njegov konj preko noći postaju senzacija na društvenim mrežama kada njihov stvarni obračun s uterivačima dugova postane viralan.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Deca bez granica
programme.desc: Ešton, Selest i Beka su troje neobičnih srednjoškolskih otpadnika koji formiraju klub u napuštenom pozorištu. Tamo upoznaju Čarlija (Bil Kobs), beskućnika koji deli njihovu ljubav prema muzičkom pozorištu. Kad saznaju za plan da se pozorište sruši, tinejdžeri pokušavaju da ga spasu modernom izvedbom Šekspirovog komada "Mnogo buke ni oko čega". Tokom pripreme predstave, deca uče da se prema drugima odnose s poštovanjem i da se bore za svoja uverenja. U filmu igra i Li Meriveder, nominovana za Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Strašna strana istorije: Pokvareni Rimljani
programme.desc: Mladi Rimljanin Ati primoran je da se pridruži rimskoj vojsci kada jedna od njegovih "lukavih smicalica" zasmeta lično Neronu. Šalju ga u "bednu, hladnu i vlažnu Britaniju", čiji se stanovnici bune. Stvari postaju još gore kad Atija zarobi Orla, opasna mlada Keltkinja koja gori od želje da se dokaže kao ratnica. Nakon što je za dlaku izbegao vrlo gadan kraj u močvari, Ati koristi znanje stečeno u Rimu kako bi pomogao Orli da spase svoju baku, koju je kidnapovalo suparničko pleme. U međuvremenu, besni Neron odlučuje da uguši pobunu koju predvodi Budika, kraljica Icenija. Ati se ponovo pridružuje rimskim trupama i otkriva da se spremaju za istorijski obračun sa Keltima u bici kod Votling strita. Ati bi mogao sve da zaustavi, ali i da dovede do katastrofe za Orlu, jer se dvoje novopečenih prijatelja sada nalaze na suprotnim stranama bojnog polja.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Polje izgubljenih cipela
programme.desc: Zasnovano na istinitoj priči iz Američkog građanskog rata. Kadetski tinejdžeri sa Vojnog instituta u Virdžiniji, zaštićeni od ratnih užasa, iznenada su pozvani da brane dolinu Šenandoa u bici kod Nju Marketa 1864. godine. Primorani da prerano ostave svoju mladost iza sebe, ovi kadeti moraju odlučiti za šta se tačno bore.

programme.title: Poslednji ples
programme.desc: Nakon tragedije, poznata plesna kompanija iz Njujorka nalazi se na ivici kolapsa. Iako su napustili svet plesa zauvek, Travis, Krisa i Maks imaju poslednju šansu da ponovo pronađu strast i dokažu da čuda zaista mogu da se dogode.

programme.title: Istinita priča
programme.desc: Džejms Franko i Džona Hil u napetom trileru o čoveku optuženom za ubistvo porodice i osramoćenom novinaru čiji je identitet preuzeo ubica _ sve dok ne bude razotkriven.

programme.title: Dnevnik Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Na startu Nove godine, 32-godišnja Bridžet odlučuje da preuzme kontrolu nad svojim životom i počinje da vodi dnevnik. Ubrzo se nađe rastrzana između šarmantnog Danijela i ozbiljnog Marka, dok posao i prijatelji dodatno komplikuju njen haotični svet.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns na ivici razuma
programme.desc: Četiri nedelje od početka njene nove veze, Bridžet počinje da sumnja u Marka. Osim što otkriva da glasa za konzervativce, suočava se s novim šefom, čudnim saradnikom i najgorim odmorom u životu.

programme.title: Beba Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Nakon raskida s Markom Darsijem, Bridžet, ponovo sama i u svojim četrdesetim, posvećuje se poslu i prijateljima, uverena da sve drži pod kontrolom. A onda upoznaje šarmantnog Amerikanca Džeka i ostaje trudna. Problem je u tome što nije sigurna ko bi mogao biti otac.

programme.title: Putinov rat iz senke
programme.desc: Uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija o tome kako se razvija Putinov rat iz senke u nordijskim zemljama, i u ostatku Evrope. Duže od godinu dana, ekipa nagrađivanih istraživačkih novinara i dokumentarista nordijskih državnih televizija DR, NRK, YLE i SVT su istraživali i snimali širom Evrope to kako Rusi operišu pod maskom u tom delu sveta. Rezultat je zastrašujući i otkriva jezive obrasce i uglove gledanja. Usred istrage, sabotaža gasnog sistema Severni tok čini situaciju očiglednijom i zahteva bliže ispitivanje aktivnosti ruske vojske u zapadnim društvima.

programme.title: Staljingrad
programme.desc: Bitka za Staljingrad bila je najkrvaviji, ali odlučujući sukob u ratu do istrebljenja koji je pokrenuo Hitler. Odnela je živote najmanje milion nemačkih i sovjetskih vojnika, kao i sovjetskih civila. Staljingrad je označio psihološku prekretnicu u Drugom svetskom ratu, jer je poraz 6. armije mnoge Nemce suočio sa spoznajom da će, uprkos svoj propagandi, rat biti izgubljen. Ova serija prikazuje kako se katastrofa odvijala i kakve je stravične posledice bitka ostavila na vojnike i stanovnike grada.

programme.title: Fukušima: Priroda u zoni opasnosti
programme.desc: Na istočnoj obali Japana nalaze se gradovi koji su nakon sudbonosne nuklearne katastrofe u Fukušimi 2011, napušteni od strane ljudi. To je područje za koje se smatralo da više nije pogodno za život _ ali životinje koje tamo obitavaju imaju drugačije mišljenje. U ovom jednosatnom specijalu istražujemo život u zoni nuklearne katastrofe, prateći međunarodnu grupu stručnjaka koji proučavaju životinje što prkose svim izgledima i uspevaju ne obazirajući se na otrovno okruženje. Pogledajte kako pokušavamo da razumemo divlje, opasno i iznenađujuće u dokumentarcu "Fukušima: Priroda u zoni opasnosti".

programme.title: Kad mi progovorimo
programme.desc: Tri uzbunjivačice dele svoje motive, iskustva i posledice svojih slučajeva. Ketrin Gan, prevoditeljica u britanskoj obaveštajnoj službi, Helen Evans, rukovoditeljica u Oksfamu, i Rouz Makgauan, holivudska glumica, otkrivaju šta se desi ženama u emisiji Kada mi progovorimo. Kada mi progovorimo je snimana tokom dve godine, prateći tri neverovatne priče žena koje su rizikovale sve kako bi ispričale istinu. Uzbunjivači retko kada razumeju kakav će uticaj pričanje istine imati na njihov život. Kada mi progovorimo priča priču o ženama u središtu čuvenih razoktrivanja, otkrivajući nam šta ih je navelo da progovore. Njihove priče postale su svetski skandali koji su ih u privatnom životu mnogo koštali.

programme.title: Milijarderi koji su stvorili naš svet
programme.desc: Ovo je definišuća dokumentarna serija o četvorici najmoćnijih muškaraca na planeti, koji su oblikovali naše živote i postali možda i najbogatiji ljudi u istoriji... Bil Gejts, Džef Bezos, Mark Zakerberg i Ilon Mask. Ovi ljudi imaju toliko bogatstva i uticaja da prevazilaze većinu država i demokratski izabranih vođa. Oni su oblikovali naše živote, političke sudbine država, a imaju dovoljno moći da pokreću tržišta i menjaju tok istorije svojim poslovanjem i jednim javljanjem putem društvenih mreža. Ovaj serijal ima za cilj da objasni njihov uspon, shvati njihovu moć i predvidi našu budućnost. Svaka od epizoda istražuje jednog od ovih divova i objašnjava kako su postali multimilijarderi.

programme.title: Raj i pakao
programme.desc: U ovom intimnom i zapanjujućem uvidu u najzloglasniji kult Novog Zelanda, svoje priče kazuju bivši članovi komune Centrepoint iz 1970-ih. Godine 1978. se ruralna varošica na Novom Zelandu našla u čudu kada je čula da se radikalna seksualna komuna preselila u njihovu malu, konzervativnu zajednicu. Ko su bili ti nekonvencionalni tragači za dušom _ i ko je bio misteriozni sredovečni čovek koji je sebe nazivao njihovim guruom?

programme.title: Gde si bio četrdeset i četvrte?
programme.desc: Film Gde si bio '44 je dokumentarna fikcija o grupi ljudi zaljubljenih u ersoft, vrstu sporta u kom igrači eliminišu suparnike pucanjem iz replika oružja, koristeći plastične kuglice kao municiju. Ali film nije samo o borbi, protagonisti nam pokazuju važnost istorijskog konteksta koji je nerazdvojan od ove igre. Pored replika oružja, igrači ersofta koriste kostime, automobile i druge predmete kako bi oživeli događaje s kraja Drugog svetskog rata. Zanimljivi entuzijasti vraćaju nas u detinjstvo, kada je igranje ratnih igara bilo deo odrastanja. Ovo je priča o odraslima koje fascinira istorija, a upravo zbog posvećenosti ersoftu, oni su igru uveli u novu dimenziju _ umesto rata, to danas predstavlja igru.

programme.title: Seks i ubistvo
programme.desc: Seks i ubistvo su često povezani u krivičnim istragama; a detektivi otkrivaju prljave tajne, skandalozne seksualne afere, zavisnosti od seksa na mreži, ljubomoru i zapanjujuće iščašene fantazije, tražeći motive za ubistvo.

programme.title: Najlepša evropska sela
programme.desc: Iz radionice najvećeg veseljaka na domaćoj TV sceni, Roberta Knjaza, stiže nam nova zabavno-poučna serija (ili bolje: selija) o najslikovitijim evropskim selima. I dok većina čovečanstva hrli u gradove, mi smo krenuli u suprotnom smeru i u šest čarobnih epizoda saznali kako je živeti na selu, jesu li seljaci veseljaci i kako izgledaju najlepša evropska sela. Plavo-bela grčka Oia, bijelo andaluzijsko selo Setenil de las Bodegas i unikatno plavo selo Juzcar, šarena italijanska Manarola i Riomađore, norveški Reine _ model za film Frozen, francuski Eguisheim sa vodopadima cveća i švajcarski Lauterbrunnen sa vodopadima vode _ sva ta sela gledaćete otvorenih usta i saznati štošta o životu i običajima lokalaca. Dobićete nove ideje za romantična putovanja i otkriti kako od devet turista godišnje doći do njih devedeset hiljada.

programme.title: Velike inženjerske greške
programme.desc: Serija Katastrofalne inženjerske greške istražuje neke od najneobičnijih, a ponekad i smrtonosnih inženjerskih katastrofa širom sveta. U Njujorku otkrivamo šta je dovelo do rušenja ogromnog krana. Zemljotres na Novom Zelandu uništava prepunu poslovnu zgradu, sa tragičnim posledicama. Nesreća pogađa gradilište visokog mosta u Španiji. U Australiji eksploziv ne uspeva da sruši ogromni silos. A zašto je došlo do epskog kvara mosta u austrijskoj prestonici, Beču? Od tornja koji zviždi na vetru u Mančesteru u Velikoj Britaniji do konstrukcije koja tone u Berlinu, otkrivamo koje su inženjerske greške dovele do haosa. Uz pristup projektantskim timovima, svedocima događaja i panelu stručnjaka, analiziramo šta je pošlo po zlu, istražujemo zašto greške nisu ranije otkrivene i pokazujemo kako inženjeri rade na tome da spreče slične katastrofe u budućnosti.

programme.title: Ubice snimljene na delu
programme.desc: Dokumentarna serija o istinitim zločinima sa jedinstvenim pristupom video-snimcima koji su vodili do osuđivanja ubica širom sveta. Stručnjaci objašnjavaju kako najsavremenija tehnologija gradi vizuelni mozaik dokaza.

programme.title: Greška ubice
programme.desc: Služeći se dirljivim intervjuima i dramatičnim rekonstrukcijama, emisija "Greška ubice" istražuje fatalne greške koje su na kraju vodile do hapšenja. Priča svake žrtve je ispričana pomoću toka policijske istrage, tokom kojih su detektivi gradili slučajeve od najmanjih dokaza. Mrlje krvi, snimci sa skrivenih nadzornih kamera, pogrešna reč kazana u pogrešnom trenutku... Šta od toga može da oda ubicu? To otkrivamo na kraju svake epizode koja nosi intrigu, izazov i složenu tematiku, u seriji koja je dirljiva, ali i upućuje nas u proces istrage. Sve zavisi od jednog malog dokaza... A ako se dođe do njega, ubica ostaje slobodan.

programme.title: Ubistva među milionerima
programme.desc: Pohlepa, ljubomora, osveta, požuda i bes. Sve su to motivi za ubistvo, ali kada je u igri novac _ ulozi su još veći. U svakoj epizodi ove uzbudljive serije otkriva se novi slučaj u kome se najbogatiji ljudi sveta suočavaju sa najjezivijim ubistvima. Snimljena u raskošnom stilu; istražitelji, porodica, prijatelji i stručnjaci, uz podršku ličnih i policijskih arhiva, vode nas na napeto putovanje, puno obrta, koje otkriva kako posedovati sve može značiti da na kraju ostanete bez ičega.

programme.title: Ubistvo u umu
programme.desc: UBISTVO U UMU istražuje psihološke sile koje stoje iza ubistava koja se dešavaju u stvarnom svetu. Svaka epizoda fokusira se na jedan slučaj i kroz razgovore sa detektivima, preživelima, prijateljima i članovima porodice prati put počinioca do ubistva. Psiholozi i kriminolozi analiziraju kako su traume, upozoravajući znakovi i loše odluke postepeno doveli do smrtonosnih ishoda. Dnevnici, objave na društvenim mrežama i lični snimci samih ubica pružaju potresan uvid u njihovo psihičko stanje. Uz puno poštovanje prema žrtvama, ali bez ulepšavanja činjenica, ova serija nastoji da razume kako su se razvijale ove složene ličnosti i kako bi upravo razumevanje njihove psihologije moglo biti ključ za sprečavanje budućih tragedija.

programme.title: Kad smrt zakuca na vrata
programme.desc: Za žrtvu je to sasvim običan dan, sve dok neko ne pozvoni na video interfon … Svaka epizoda ove true crime serije prati istragu ubistva u kojoj su ključni dokazi zabeleženi kamerom interfona, ili kućnim sigurnosnim kamerama. Kroz potresne slučajeve iz Velike Britanije i SAD-a, istražitelji, stručnjaci za digitalnu forenziku, kao i prijatelji i članovi porodice žrtve pomažu da se složi slika o tome šta se zaista dogodilo.
