programme.title: Bivši, film
programme.desc: Ako je Pariz grad ljubavi…onda mora biti i grad bivših ljubavi! U Parizu, gradu Ljubavi, pet potpuno različitih parova križaju puteve u danima prekida. Antoine, psihoanalitičar i odnedavno samac, promovira svoju novu knjigu Sretan kao bivši. Greg, vozač taksija, nema nikoga da ga utješi nakon prekida. Marina će ostatak života provesti uz Sergea- ali samo ako je bivši ostavi na miru. Pater Laurent će morati vjenčati Hectora i Julie, svoju bivšu simpatiju. Didier, sudac obiteljskog suda, još uvijek gaji osjećaje prema Caroline, bivšoj ženi. Nitko od njih nema ništa zajedničko. Svi su oni nečiji bivši - ali, ljubav krene u potpuno neočekivanim smjerovima…

programme.title: Ljubav i orhideje, film
programme.desc: Za savršenoga gospodina i psihijatra Petera Newmansa misle da je gej zbog njegove brige za pacijente, ženskih susjeda i muških prijatelja koji mu zavide na njegovoj uglađenosti sa ženama. A onda su mu dijagnosticirali i operirali rijedak, neagresivan tumor na mozgu, koji mu je bio potiskivao hipofizu, hormonalni okidač puberteta. Na oduševljenje njegova oca, koji je oduvijek želio normalnog tinejdžera koji se stalno nešto buni i koji je ženskar, Peter sada prolazi fazu seksualnog sazrijevanja uz prednosti tijela muškarca i prihoda, no bez normalnoga iskustva, i to zbunjuje njega, njegove simpatije i njegove muške prijatelje.

programme.title: Još sam tu: Izgubljene godine Joaquina Phoenixa, film
programme.desc: 2008. g., dok je vježbao za humanitarni događaj, glumac Joaquin Phoenix, uz kameru Caseyja Afflecka, kaže ljudima da prekida s glumom kako bi se okušao u rap glazbi. Iduće godine, pratimo kako glumac piše, uvježbava, i izvodi pjesme pred publikom. Salijeće Seana Combsa u nadi da će mu producirati nosač zvuka. Vidimo glumca u njegovu domu dok se zabavlja, puši, viče na svoju svitu, dok filozofira s Affleckom, i dok komentira slavne.

programme.title: Označena, film
programme.desc: Kineska stipendistkinja Wei putuje na Novi Zeland kako bi studirala medicinska istraživanja. Stidljiva, povučena i skriva genetski madež na licu, Wei izbjegavaju Angela i njezine glamurozne prijateljice. Odlučna promijeniti svoju sudbinu, Wei uranja u istraživanje svog preminulog oca znanstvenika, i radi na revolucionarnom postupku presađivanja kože kojim bi mogla srediti svoj nedostatak.

programme.title: 2:22, film
programme.desc: Život Dylana Bransona trajno je izbačen iz kolosijeka kada se znakovi zlokobnih događaja ponavljaju svakoga dana prijeteći sigurnosti i životu žene koju voli. Dylan će morati razbiti moć prošlosti i preuzeti kontrolu nad događajem koji ga misteriozno privlači u Grand Central Station svakog dana u 2:22 sati.

programme.title: Povratak u Oz, film
programme.desc: Animirani i sinkronizirani mjuzikl Povratak u Oz temelji se na pustovnim knjigama čiji je autor Roger Stanton Baum, praunuk L. Franka Bauma. Nastavak jedne od najpopularnijih i najomiljenijih bajki zatiče Dorothy u vrijeme nakon što je Kansas poharao tornado, a ona se vraća u Oz i pokušava spasiti svoje stare prijatelje - Strašilo, Lava, Limenka i Glindu kojima prijeti novi zlikovac - Luda. Mudrica, časnik Šećerko, Porculanska princeza i teglenica Plovko pridružuju se Dorothy na njenom čarobnom putovanju kroz slikoviti Oz ne bi li povratila red i sreću u Emerald City. Uz glazbu koju je skladao za Oscara nominirani Bryan Adams, Povratak u Oz pravi je povratak u šarmantni i obiteljski serijal Oz.

programme.title: Posljednji lovac na vještice, film
programme.desc: Stoljećima su se cijele vojske lovaca na vještice borile protiv ovih strašnih neprijatelja širom svijeta, a među njima je bio i Kaulder, hrabri ratnik koji je uspio ubiti svemoćnu Vještičju kraljicu i pritom desetkovati njezine sljedbenike. U trenucima prije svoje smrti, Kraljica ga je proklela te učinila besmrtnim, čime ga je zauvijek odvojila od voljene supruge i kćeri. Danas je Kaulder jedini pripadnik svoje vrste i već stoljećima lovi vještice istovremeno čeznuvši za odavno izgubljenim voljenima. No Kaulder ni ne pomišlja da ga uskoro čekaju epske bitke koje će odlučiti o tome hoće li ljudska vrsta preživjeti.

programme.title: Greenland: Posljednje utočište, film
programme.desc: Kako se odbrojavanje do globalne apokalipse približava, obitelj Johna Garrityja se bori za opstanak. Zajedno sa svojim sinom Nathanom moraju krenuti na opasno putovanje kako bi se domogli jedine nade za spas, utočišta na Greenlandu. Usred zastrašujućih vijesti o uništenim gradovima širom svijeta, dok komadi kometa izazivaju katastrofu neviđenih razmjera, Garrityji doživljaju najbolje i najgore od čovječanstva, u borbi protiv sve veće panike i bezakonja koje ih okružuju. Kako se odbrojavanje do globalne apokalipse približava nuli, njihov nevjerojatan put kulminira očajničkim i posljednjim letom u moguće sigurno utočište.

programme.title: Asterix i Obelix protiv Cezara, film
programme.desc: Malo galsko selo u kojem žive Asteriks (Christian Clavier) i Obeliks (Gérard Depardieu) posljednja je oaza slobode u Galiji. Kada rimski poreznik ne uspije obaviti svoj posao u seocetu, Julije Cezar (Gottfried John) osobno dolazi posjetiti naselje kako bi se uvjerio po čemu je ono toliko posebno i kako se uspijeva obraniti od njegovih moćnih legionara. Čarobni napitak, koji smo njihov druid zna spraviti, Galima daje nadljudsku snagu pa Cezar shvati da, ako želi pokoriti te lude Gale, mora se domoći druida. Prema glasovitom romanu i jednoj od avantura najpoznatijeg francuskog dvojca, Asterixa i Obelixa, koju su napisali i nacrtali René Goscinny i Underzo, snimljena je obiteljska komična avantura namijenjena zabavi čitave obitelji. Niz generacija odraslo je na stripovima Asterixa i Obelixa pa stoga ne čudi da tate i mame, baš kao i njihova djeca, s tolikim oduševljenjem čekaju svaku novu ekranizaciju crtanih heroja. Popularnost Asterixa i Obelixa nikada ne jenjava - oni su dio francuskog kulturnog nasljeđa, pa ako ćemo i dublje analizirati - simbol ponosa, otpora i neustrašivosti Francuza. Dva poznata francuska glumca, Christian Clavier i Gérard Depardieu, preuzeli su glavne uloge, dok nas je u ulozi smutljivca i mutivode Tulliusa Destructivusa svojom izvedbom oduševio poznati talijan Roberto Benigni. Pripremite se za mnogo makljže i smijeha jer to su dvije stvari (uz obaveznog pečenog vepra) koje stanovnici malog galskog sela najviše vole!

programme.title: Asterix i Obelix: Srednje kraljevstvo, film
programme.desc: Godina je 50. pr. Kr., i kineska je carica zatvorena nakon državnog udara koji je potaknuo princ izdajica. Uz pomoć feničkog trgovca i njezinog vjernog tjelohranitelja, caričina jedina kći princeza Sass-Yi bježi u Galiju kako bi zatražila pomoć dvojice hrabrih ratnika Asterixa i Obelixa, koji su zahvaljujući svom čarobnom napitku obdareni nadljudskom snagom. Naša dva nerazdvojna heroja rado prihvaćaju pomoći i tako počinje veliko putovanje i avantura na putu za Kinu. Ali Cezar i njegova moćna vojska, žedni novog osvajanja, također idu prema Srednjem kraljevstvu...

programme.title: Peti element, film
programme.desc: Znanstveno-fantastični film o savršenom biću, prelijepoj Leeloo, koja jedina može spasiti zemlju od zlih sila. Svakih pet tisuća godina otvaraju se vrata koja dijele dvije dimenzije. U jednoj je svemir s mnoštvom najraznovrsnijih oblika života, a u drugoj element koji nije načinjen od zemlje, zraka, vatre ili vode, već od anti-energije, anti-života. Ta ]stvar^, tama, na pragu svemira strpljivo čeka prigodu kako bi uništila svekoliki život i svjetlo. Prekrasna mlada žena Leeloo, savršena duha i tijela, jedina može sjediniti moć četiriju drevnih elementa koji održavaju život - zemlju, zrak, vatru i vodu - kako bi spasila Zemlju od nasrtaja sila anti-života. No iako je stvorena kao vječno i DNA-reinkarnirano savršenstvo života radi spasa čitavog svijeta od sila zla, i samoj joj je potrebna zaštita koju će joj pružiti Korben Dallas, newyorški taksist iz 23. stoljeća - junak potreban svemiru svakih pet tisuća godina.

programme.title: Kuća straha, film
programme.desc: Dva para zajedno iznajme luksuznu kuću iz snova, da bi zatim otkrili kako ih vlasnik potajno špijunira. Nakon dugo vremena, ono što je trebao biti slavljenički izlet za vikend, pretvara se u nešto daleko zlokobnije. Počinju se otkrivati dobro čuvane tajne i četvero starih prijatelja se međusobno počinju doživljavati u potpuno novom svjetlu. Od tog trenutka stvari krenu nizbrdo i s vlasnikom i s njihovim međusobnim odnosom te oni odluče ujutro napustiti kuću. No naravno, treba preživjeti noć.

programme.title: U šumi, film
programme.desc: U bliskoj budućnosti, sestre tinejdžerice, Nell i Eva, žive s ocem u kući usred šume. Zbog problema sa strujom, ne radi im ništa od tehnologije Tata im se ozbiljno ozlijedio pilom, i ubrzo nakon toga je umro. Prije smrti rekao je sestrama da se brinu jedna o drugoj. Nakon dva mjeseca djevojke ostaju bez hrane. Prijatelj Eli, u kojega je Nell zaljubljena, dolazi do njih i nagovara Nell da pođe s njim u Boston, gdje možda ima još struje. Jednoga dana, neznanci napadnu Evu i siluju je. Kad otkrije da je trudna, odlučuje zadržati dijete, jer više nikoga ne želi izgubiti. Snažna oluja uništi dom sestara. Odluče zapaliti kuću i otići u šumu.

Jednoga dana, neznanci napadnu Evu i siluju je. Kad otkrije da je trudna, odlučuje zadržati dijete, jer više nikoga ne želi izgubiti. Snažna oluja uništi dom sestara. Odluče zapaliti kuću i otići u šumu.

programme.title: Priče o duhovima, film
programme.desc: Profesor Philip Goodman (ANDY NYMAN) slavni je skeptik prema svemu natpirodnomu. Dobio je priliku istražiti tri nerazjašnjena paranormalna slučaja i otkrije misterije kakve nije mogao ni zamisliti. To ga dovodi do strašnih, šokantnih, ali i osobnih zaključaka…

programme.title: Oto: Istraživač dubina, film
programme.desc: Godina je 2100., ljudi su napustili Zemlju, a kolonija ekstravagantnih bića još uvijek preživljava u najdubljem ponoru oceana. Deep, avanturistička hobotnica posljednja od svoje vrste, živi dolje sa svoja dva bezuvjetna prijatelja: Evom, štreberskom i nespretnom ribom, i Alice, neurotičnom škampicom. Kada nesreća razori njihov dom, čuvar ponora, Kraken, poslat će Deepa i njegove prijatelje na opasan put u potrazi za novim domom. U misiji će im se pridružiti Maura te će zajedno putovati na nevjerojatna mjesta, poput potopljenog New Yorka, Titanika i Arktika.

programme.title: Asterix i Obelix protiv Cezara, film
programme.desc: Malo galsko selo u kojem žive Asteriks (Christian Clavier) i Obeliks (Gérard Depardieu) posljednja je oaza slobode u Galiji. Kada rimski poreznik ne uspije obaviti svoj posao u seocetu, Julije Cezar (Gottfried John) osobno dolazi posjetiti naselje kako bi se uvjerio po čemu je ono toliko posebno i kako se uspijeva obraniti od njegovih moćnih legionara. Čarobni napitak, koji smo njihov druid zna spraviti, Galima daje nadljudsku snagu pa Cezar shvati da, ako želi pokoriti te lude Gale, mora se domoći druida. Prema glasovitom romanu i jednoj od avantura najpoznatijeg francuskog dvojca, Asterixa i Obelixa, koju su napisali i nacrtali René Goscinny i Underzo, snimljena je obiteljska komična avantura namijenjena zabavi čitave obitelji. Niz generacija odraslo je na stripovima Asterixa i Obelixa pa stoga ne čudi da tate i mame, baš kao i njihova djeca, s tolikim oduševljenjem čekaju svaku novu ekranizaciju crtanih heroja. Popularnost Asterixa i Obelixa nikada ne jenjava - oni su dio francuskog kulturnog nasljeđa, pa ako ćemo i dublje analizirati - simbol ponosa, otpora i neustrašivosti Francuza. Dva poznata francuska glumca, Christian Clavier i Gérard Depardieu, preuzeli su glavne uloge, dok nas je u ulozi smutljivca i mutivode Tulliusa Destructivusa svojom izvedbom oduševio poznati talijan Roberto Benigni. Pripremite se za mnogo makljže i smijeha jer to su dvije stvari (uz obaveznog pečenog vepra) koje stanovnici malog galskog sela najviše vole!

programme.title: Asterix i Obelix: Srednje kraljevstvo, film
programme.desc: Godina je 50. pr. Kr., i kineska je carica zatvorena nakon državnog udara koji je potaknuo princ izdajica. Uz pomoć feničkog trgovca i njezinog vjernog tjelohranitelja, caričina jedina kći princeza Sass-Yi bježi u Galiju kako bi zatražila pomoć dvojice hrabrih ratnika Asterixa i Obelixa, koji su zahvaljujući svom čarobnom napitku obdareni nadljudskom snagom. Naša dva nerazdvojna heroja rado prihvaćaju pomoći i tako počinje veliko putovanje i avantura na putu za Kinu. Ali Cezar i njegova moćna vojska, žedni novog osvajanja, također idu prema Srednjem kraljevstvu...

programme.title: Peti element, film
programme.desc: Znanstveno-fantastični film o savršenom biću, prelijepoj Leeloo, koja jedina može spasiti zemlju od zlih sila. Svakih pet tisuća godina otvaraju se vrata koja dijele dvije dimenzije. U jednoj je svemir s mnoštvom najraznovrsnijih oblika života, a u drugoj element koji nije načinjen od zemlje, zraka, vatre ili vode, već od anti-energije, anti-života. Ta ]stvar^, tama, na pragu svemira strpljivo čeka prigodu kako bi uništila svekoliki život i svjetlo. Prekrasna mlada žena Leeloo, savršena duha i tijela, jedina može sjediniti moć četiriju drevnih elementa koji održavaju život - zemlju, zrak, vatru i vodu - kako bi spasila Zemlju od nasrtaja sila anti-života. No iako je stvorena kao vječno i DNA-reinkarnirano savršenstvo života radi spasa čitavog svijeta od sila zla, i samoj joj je potrebna zaštita koju će joj pružiti Korben Dallas, newyorški taksist iz 23. stoljeća - junak potreban svemiru svakih pet tisuća godina.

programme.title: Superćelija, film
programme.desc: William, sin legendarnog lovca na oluje Billa Brodyja, kao dijete je oca izgubio u tornadu. Sada kao tinejdžer u potrazi za identitetom, kreće tatinim stopama. Na tom putovanju, William pronalazi svoje obiteljsko ime na logotipu turističke tvrtke specijalizirane za lov na oluje koja koristi ostavštinu njegova oca kako bi napunila vlastite džepove. Obiteljski posao sada pripada Zaneu Rogersu, nesmotrenom turoperatoru koji vidi dolare tamo gdje drugi vide olujne oblake. Kad mu sudbina stigne u obliku jedne od najjačih zabilježenih oluja, William napušta majku i dom kako bi se udružio s očevim bivšim partnerom koji je jedva preživio tornado. Roy, stari partner Willamova oca, pokušava ga zaštititi od opasnosti, no majka priroda ima drugačije planove.

programme.title: Duh u oklopu, film
programme.desc: 'Duh u oklopu' temeljen je na međunarodno priznatom SF naslijeđu, japanskom animiranom filmu iz 1995. godine, kojeg je režirao Mamoru Oshii prema istoimenoj mangi iz 1991. godine. Radnja je smještena u 2029. Godinu, kada su mnogi ljudi postali kiborzi zamijenivši neke svoje dijelove tijela umjetnim implantatima. No mozak se ne može zamijeniti te on predstavlja „duha, tj. ljudski identitet koji se nalazi u oklopu mehaničkog tijela. Radnja filma prati Major (Scarlet Johansson), koja vodi elitnu postrojbu pod nazivom Sektor 9, zaduženu za najopasnije kriminalce. Njihov zadatak je zaustaviti ih, te će se morati suočiti s neprijateljem čiji je jedini cilj uništiti napredak tehnologije Hank Robotic’s-a.

programme.title: Tajna broja sedam, film
programme.desc: U ne tako dalekoj budućnosti, zbog prekomjerne populacije i gladi, vlada je ograničila obitelji na samo jedno dijete. Sedam identičnih sestara, koje su imena dobile po danima u tjednu, živi skriveno te svaki dan jedna izlazi van pod istim identitetom. Međutim, jednoga dana se sestra koja izlazi ponedjeljkom ne vrati a ostale sestre krenu istraživati njezin nestanak…

programme.title: Sjena straha, film
programme.desc: U jeku Drugog svjetskog rata, kapetanica Maude Garrett pridružuje se muškoj posadi bombardera B-17 s vrlo tajnim paketom. Zatečena prisutnošću žene u vojnom letu, posada testira svaki Maudein pokret. Neobična događanja i rupe u njezinoj prošlosti potiču paranoju oko njene prave misije. Ali posada se mora bojati nečeg drugog ... nečeg što vreba iz sjene i zlokobno razdire srce aviona.

programme.title: Čudovišta: Mračni kontinent, film
programme.desc: Smješten desetljeće nakon događaja iz SF hita Garetha Edwardsa ČUDOVIŠTA, u ovom nastavku prepunom akcije njegova izvanzemaljska čudovišta rasprostranila su se do Bliskog istoka. U pokušaju da smanji njihov broj američka vojska postavila je svoje snage u neimenovanu bliskoistočnu zemlju, gdje redovito projektilima gađa pustinju - što rezultira brojnim truplima divovskih čudovišta, ali i velikim brojem žrtava među običnim ljudima. Zbog toga vojska vodi rat na dvije fronte boreći se s pobunjenicima naoružanim RPGS-ovima i improviziranim eksplozivima, ali i s čudovištima koja tutnjaju kroz pustinju.

programme.title: Arthurovo prokletstvo, film
programme.desc: Alex je 18-godišnji mladić koji je godinama veliki obožavatelj sage o fantastičnom serijalu Arthur i Minimoys. Grupa prijatelja ga je za rođendan iznenadila prijedlogom da odu u napuštenu kuću u kojoj se snimao film. Nisu svjesni da će upasti u smrtonosnu zavjeru. Ono što je nekada bio san iz djetinjstva, uskoro će se pretvoriti u pravu noćnu moru.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav, film
programme.desc: Adam i Eden upoznali su se kao tinejdžeri kad se on penjao na planinu da se približi svijetu kamo mu je bio zabranjen pristup. Kad su ih otkrili, odmah su ih razdvojili. Otad je prošlo deset godina, Adam (J. Sturgess) se bavi receptima svoje pratete i ugleda na TV-u Eden (K. Dunst). Odluči doći do nje bez obzira na opasnosti i prepreke koje ga čekaju na tom putu te se izboriti za ljubav...

programme.title: Vrata u drugu dimenziju, film
programme.desc: Fizičarka koja se bavi česticama tuguje zbog gubitka supruga kojega je izgubila u prometnoj nezgodi putuje u paralelni svijet kako bi ga ponovno pronašla, sa strašnim posljedicama za svoju obitelj.

programme.title: Lov na Marsupilamija, film
programme.desc: Kad reporter Dan Geraldo (Alain Chabat) dođe u Palombiju u lov na vijest, nije ni očekivao da će imati neočekivano otkriće… Sa svojim dosjetljivim mjesnim vodičem Pablitom (Jamel Debbouze), Dan doživljava iznenađenje za iznenađenjem u tijeku ove uzbudljive pustolovine koja mu pruža mogućnost da svijetu donese spektakularne vijesti: Marsupilami, mitska i nestašna životinja, doista postoji! I vi ćete povjerovati u dlakave repove!

programme.title: Dolina bogova, film
programme.desc: Film spaja tri zasebne radnje kako bi stvorila epsku fantastičnu priču. Razvedeni pisac John Ecas (Josh Hartnett) angažiran je kako bi napisao biografiju najbogatijeg čovjeka na svijetu, povučenog Wesa Taurosa (John Malkovich). John ne zna da je zemlja kojom korača sveta i da je u sporu između industrijalca bogataša Wesa Taurosa (John Malkovich), koji zemlju želi minirati zbog urana, i borbenog lokalnog indijanskog plemena Navajo. Taurosovi postupci otkrivaju bića iz Navajo legendi za koje se smatralo da nisu ništa više od mita. Dok se tri strane sukobljavaju, predodžbe o tome što je doista vrijedno dolaze u fokus kad bogovi starih ratuju protiv želja modernog čovjeka.

programme.title: Stranci: Prvo poglavlje, film
programme.desc: U centru zbivanja je mladi par putuje preko granice kako bi započeli novi život; nažalost, na putu prema sjeveru im se pokvari auto. Zarobljeni tokom noći u Oregonu, par se prijavljuje u osamljeni Airbnb. Nedugo nakon smještanja troje nepoznatih ljudi ih počinju maltretirati, a borba za život tek počinje.

programme.title: U električnoj izmaglici, film
programme.desc: New Iberia u Louisiani. Detektiv Dave Robicheaux u lovu je na serijskog ubojicu koji vreba mlade žene. Putem kući s još jednoga stravičnog mjesta zločina, Dave upoznaje glamuroznu holivudsku zvijezdu Elroda Sykesa. Sykes je u gradu radi svoga novog filma koji snima uz potporu lokalnoga zločinačkog kralja Baby Feet Balbonija. Sykes ispriča Daveu kako je u močvari vidio leš – raspadnuto tijelo crnca u lancima. To otkriće kod Davea izaziva bujicu sjećanja iz vlastite prošlosti. On predosjeća da su ta dva slučaja povezana. I dok se Dave sve više približava ubojici, ubojica se sve više približava Daveu i njegovoj obitelji.

programme.title: Godina morskog psa, film
programme.desc: Nestanak turista stavlja atlantsku obalu u stanje visoke pripravnosti: morski pas je u francuskim vodama! Maja, članica obalne straže na pragu mirovine, odlazi u svoju posljednju misiju spašavanja zaljeva…

programme.title: Tijelo, film
programme.desc: Crnohumorna i uvrnuta radnja TIJELA odvija se jedne nezaboravne Badnje večeri i prati tri studentice čija provala pođe po zlu. Kad se odšuljaju u osamljenu vilu na zabavu, djevojke se suočavaju s teškim izborima nakon što neočekivano susretnu čuvara imanja. Nakon slučajne nesreće djevojke se upletu u hičkokovsku noćnu moru punu napetosti, sumnje, prijevare i ubojstva, gdje nikomu ne treba vjerovati, a novi obrat leži iza svakog ugla.

programme.title: Upoznao sam ubojicu na internetu

programme.title: Svjedoci ubojstva: Digitalni dokaz

programme.title: Spoj, vjenčanje, ubojstvo, Andrew Parsons

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Yeardley Love

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Paper wasn't always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Disasters in the air and misfortunes at sea grab our attention because of the unusually large number of fatalities involved. But it's not even necessary to leave dry land for a terrible disaster to happen. Rail journeys and even just getting in your car can be fraught with disaster. That's the focus for this instalment of Desperate Hours _ road and rail disasters. We will examine the causes of such accidents, be that the powers of nature or human folly. We are about to explore the worst of the worst destructive events from an ordinary day on Nigerian roads to a disastrous display of human error in Santiago de Compostella when the driver of a loaded passenger train went about 115 km/h over the established speed limit and drove his train straight into a wall. So buckle up; you're in for a bumpy ride…

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or "chumming" _ attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther _ carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Their bodies have long turned to dust, but the spirits of the original owners who built Bellewood remain in charge and don't mind chasing out tresspassers.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped _ the stellar sea lion To help understand why their numbers are dropping, researchers work with the highly intelligent mammals at a unique floating laboratory. At The Open Water Research Station, free swimming seals and sea lions are observed in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let's face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don't know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don't know much _ and certainly not nearly enough _ about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it's little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: This angry spirit doesn't like being dead and still considers himself the sole owner of lovely Oaklands Mansion.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bonjour! We're headed to Quebec Province on today's show. First, we get blown away by the thunderous pipes at Montreal's Notre Dame Basilica. After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of a mountain bike action movie with the top riders in the world hitting new stunts and tricks that will elevate the sport of freeride mountain biking.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A team of surfers and kayakers have gathered together in Costa Rica to search out world-class surf breaks, remote rivers and virgin waterfalls.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein's theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Uhvati svaki val: Život Lairda Hamiltona
programme.desc: Laird Hamilton je možda najveći surfer velikih valova svih vremena, živa legenda koja je ukrotila neke od najmoćnijih svjetskih valova. Među surferskom zajednicom, on je također jedna od najkontroverznijih figura, inovator koji je revolucionirao ovaj sport često na ogorčenje purista. Ovaj uzbudljivi portret izbliza prati Hamiltonovo izvanredno putovanje, od njegovog buntovnog djetinjstva na Havajima preko neustrašivih početaka u surfanju, do njegove neumorne potrage za sve većim valovima, potrage koja ga je na kraju dovela do osvajanja onoga što se naziva "najtežim valom ikada". Spajajući iskrene intervjue s akcijskim snimkama od kojih zastaje dah, „Uhvati svaki val: Život Lairda Hamiltona je pogled na život proživljen na rubu.

programme.title: Nacionalna sigurnost: Priča o Arneu Treholtu
programme.desc: Godine 1985. uhićenje karizmatičnog diplomata i bivšeg državnog tajnika Arnea Treholta šokirao je njegovu rodnu Norvešku. Osuđen na 20 godina zatvora zbog špijunaže za Sovjetski Savez i Irak, Treholt i dalje poriče sve optužbe do današnjeg dana. Proveo je devet godina u strogo čuvanom zatvoru, do puštanja na slobodu početkom 90-ih, nakon što ga je pomilovala norveška vlada. S ekskluzivnim pristupom Treholtu, onima koji su bliski skandalu i stručnjacima za međunarodnu špijunažu, ovaj šestodijelni dokumentarac snimljen u New Yorku, Norveškoj i Rusiji priča fascinantnu priču o tome kako je uglednu javnu osobu s glamuroznom suprugom zavela ruska obavještajna služba.

programme.title: Blago koje su ukrali Britanci
programme.desc: Utemeljena na podcastu, „Blago koje su ukrali Britanci (Stuff The British Stole) je dokumentarna serija koja otkriva povijest Britanskog Carstva. U svakoj epizodi, nagrađeni novinar Marc Fennell odabire ukradeni predmet i vodi vas na globalnu avanturu kroz divlju, zabavnu i vizualno zapanjujuću priču o tome kako je ukradeni predmet dospio do mjesta na kojem se danas nalazi i tko to želi natrag. Marc Fennell će otkriti globalne priče o pogrešnim pljačkama, ratovima, spletkama, junaštvu i preživljavanju. Naposljetku, ovo nije serija o prošlosti, već o razumijevanju današnjeg svijeta. Čak i ako mislite da znate ovu priču, ova serija dokazuje da je povijest sve samo ne jasna.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: U dolini rijeke Wye Rosa i Craig preuređuju naslijeđenu željezničku vodospremu u obiteljski dom. Međutim, tijekom renovacije suočavaju se s pandemijom, brojnim financijskim problemima, trudnoćom i radovima koji umjesto jedne traju tri godine. Hoće li kuća biti vrijedna napora?

programme.title: John McEnroe: U carstvu savršenstva
programme.desc: Ovaj inovativni dokumentarac kroz bogatstvo 16 mm snimki prikazuje tenisku zvijezdu Johna McEnroea na vrhuncu njegove karijere, kada se, kao najbolji tenisač na svijetu, natjecao na Roland Garrosu 1984. godine. Kroz krupne planove i usporene sekvence koje prikazuju njegovu igru, kao i kroz trenutke u kojima bi na terenu planuo i bjesnio, film otkriva "čovjeka koji je igrao na rubu svojih osjetila". Daleko od tradicionalnog sportskog dokumentarca, „John McEnroe: U carstvu savršenstva istražuje McEnroeovu igru, stvarajući očaravajuću, uzbudljivu studiju vrhunskog sportaša i ljudskog tijela u pokretu.

programme.title: Drugačija divljina
programme.desc: Na maloj farmi u norveškoj šumi Payneovi žive izoliranim životom u želji da budu divlji i slobodni. Maria, Nik i njihovo četvero djece - Ulv, Falk, Freja i Ronja - dovoljni su sami sebi. Djeca se školuju kod kuće, a svi zajedno i teže povezanoj obiteljskoj dinamici i životu u skladu s prirodom. Međutim, kada obitelj pogodi tragedija, njihov je idilični svijet narušen te su prisiljeni prokrčiti nov put u moderno društvo.

programme.title: Drugačija divljina

programme.title: Ja nisam tvoj crnac
programme.desc: Američki pisac James Baldwin 1979. započeo je je rad na tekstu Remember this House. Osobna sjećanja na njegova tri ubijena prijatelja i borca za ljudska prava - Malcolma X, Medgara Eversa i Martina Luthera Kinga - ponovno su pisala američku povijest. Tih trideset neobjavljenih stranica pretvorio je u snažan kolaž arhivskih fotografija, filmskih odsječaka i snimaka TV-vijesti vezanih za bojkot i otpor rasne segregacije u 50-im i 60-ima - od nevidljivosti tamnoputih Amerikanaca u holivudskim filmovima, afroameričkih protesta protiv brutalnosti bijelih policajaca, Baldwinova kompleksnog odnosa spram pokreta Black Power pa do paranoičnog pogleda FBI-ja na Baldwinovu homoseksualnost. Prodoran i uznemirujući esej o stvarnom životu afričkih Amerikanaca koji većina američke srednje struje još uvijek ignorira.

programme.title: Priča o jezeru
programme.desc: „Priča o jezeru film je o tisućama jezera po kojima je Finska poznata. Odvodi gledatelje u neviđenu avanturu, u rasponu od kristalno čistih izvora pa sve do slivova velikih jezera. Gledateljima otvara čitav novi svijet podvodne prirode i govori o mnogim starim pričama i vjerovanjima u zemlji tisuća jezera. Priča o filmu ispričana je kroz priče koje se temelje na mitovima, legendama i starim vjerovanjima koja su dio finske mitologije.

programme.title: Zašto smo kreativni?
programme.desc: Kao dio osobnog istraživanja, redatelj Hermann Vaske više je od 30 godina snimao svjetski najintrigantnije umjetnike i intelektualce, više od njih 50 najutjecajnijih, među kojima su osvajači Nobela i Oscara, i to na polju vizualne umjetnosti, glazbe, glume, filozofije, politike, znanosti i poslovanja, kojima je postavio pitanje „Zašto ste kreativni?. Među Vaskeovim sugovornicima našli su se David Bowie, Ai Weiwei, Björk, Wim Wenders, Philippe Stark, Yoko Ono, John Hegarty, David Lynch, Yohji Yamamoto, Damien Hirst, Angelina Jolie, Nobuyoshi Araki, Quentin Tarantino, Bono, Nick Cave, Neo Rauch, Stephen Hawkins, the Dalai Lama, Peter Ustinov, Marina Abramovic, Diane Kruger, Julian Schnabel, John Cleese, Jimmy Page, Vivienne Westwood, Takeshi Kitano i drugi.

programme.title: Zašto smo kreativni?
programme.desc: Kao dio osobnog istraživanja, redatelj Hermann Vaske više je od 30 godina snimao svjetski najintrigantnije umjetnike i intelektualce, više od njih 50 najutjecajnijih, među kojima su osvajači Nobela i Oscara, i to na polju vizualne umjetnosti, glazbe, glume, filozofije, politike, znanosti i poslovanja, kojima je postavio pitanje „Zašto ste kreativni?. programme.title: Pozor: Ekstreman život
programme.desc: Ovaj hvaljeni i nagrađivani dokumentarni film prati trojicu sportaša koji se bavi zahtjevnim ekstremnim sportovima. Oni lete među planinskim lancima, bez kisika zaranjaju u morske dubine, a mogućnosti i sposobnosti ljudskog organizma dokazuju tijekom dugačkih vožnji bicikla. Zbog kojih motiva i razmišljanja su postali modernim junacima? Što uzrokuje naše divljenje ovim pojedincima koji se upuštaju u nevjerojatne rizike? Film „Pozor: Ekstreman život prati trojicu sportaša u pokušaju otkrivanja granica njihovih mogućnosti. Upoznat ćemo se s njihovim okolišem, njihovim suputnicima, ali također ćemo slušati i glasove upozorenja. Čut ćemo želje i strahove njihovih obitelji i bliskih prijatelja te ući duboko u njihovu psihu. Koji motivi su važni za njihove domete? Je li to želja za slavom? Za besmrtnošću? Ili jednostavno za životnim iskustvom?

programme.title: Bosch: Vrt zemaljskih naslada, film
programme.desc: U cijeloj povijesti slikarske umjetnosti ne postoji enigmatičnija slika od ove. Razuzdana fantazija ovog erotskog delirija, njezine skrivene poruke i poetična fabula stoljećima su fascinirale sve one koji su bili toliko sretni da izbliza pogledaju ovaj triptih. Nitko zapravo nije siguran gdje treba gledati, ali nitko ne može prestati dešifrirati značaj ove slike. Što je ona zapravo? Što prikazuje? Ovaj triptih još je uvijek okružen velom misterije, ali u isto vrijeme na njemu su nacrtani elementi koji mogu zadovoljiti svačiji ukus: jake boje, kompleksna akcija, komedija, tragedija, mističnost, grijeh, život, smrt i, možda, čak i iskupljenje. Bez obzira na to što nije dešifrirano, ovo umjetničko djelo i dalje se smatra iznimno važnim i zaokuplja pažnju gledatelja bez otkrivanja pravog značenja. Upravo se zbog toga tisuće ljudi na dnevnoj bazi okupljaju u sobi gdje je slika postavljena kako bi pokušali dešifrirati najljepši hijeroglif ikada nacrtan.

programme.desc: Američki pisac James Baldwin 1979. započeo je je rad na tekstu Remember this House. Osobna sjećanja na njegova tri ubijena prijatelja i borca za ljudska prava - Malcolma X, Medgara Eversa i Martina Luthera Kinga - ponovno su pisala američku povijest. Ovaj triptih još je uvijek okružen velom misterije, ali u isto vrijeme na njemu su nacrtani elementi koji mogu zadovoljiti svačiji ukus: jake boje, kompleksna akcija, komedija, tragedija, mističnost, grijeh, život, smrt i, možda, čak i iskupljenje. Bez obzira na to što nije dešifrirano, ovo umjetničko djelo i dalje se smatra iznimno važnim i zaokuplja pažnju gledatelja bez otkrivanja pravog značenja. Upravo se zbog toga tisuće ljudi na dnevnoj bazi okupljaju u sobi gdje je slika postavljena kako bi pokušali dešifrirati najljepši hijeroglif ikada nacrtan.

programme.title: Kleptokrati
programme.desc: Ovo je najveća svjetska prevara koja uključuje korupciju u vladi na najvišoj razini, zloupotrebu ovlasti i međunarodno pranje novca. Elitni financijaši pronevjerili su 3,5 milijardi dolara iz državnog fonda Malezije po imenu 1MDB (1Malaysia Development Berhad). Novac iz ove bezočne prevare prebačen je u New York i Hollywood kojim su lopovi privlačili najveće zvijezde, pa su tako financirali Leonardu di Capriu film „Vuk s Wall Streeta. No, istraživački novinari New York Timesa, Wall Street Journala i Hollywood Reportera pratili su trag novca i razotkrili prevaru. Američko Ministarstvo pravosuđa se uključilo, ministar i njegovi suradnici su osumnjičeni, imovina je zamrznuta, novac zaplijenjen a narod Malezije odlučio je uzvratiti udarac.

programme.title: Little Richard: Ja sam sve, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film Lise Cortés, prikazan na otvorenju Sundance festivala, donosi priču o crnačkim queer korijenima rock 'n' rolla, koji su uzdrmali bjelačko orijentirani kanon američke pop glazbe i tu otkrivamo inovatora i začetnika - Richarda Pennimana. Film nam uz bogatstvo arhivskih snimki i izvedbi približava njegov zamršeni intimni svijet te donosi životnu priču legende, sa svim njezinim usponima i padovima i svim proturječjima. Uz intervjue s obitelji, glazbenicima i cijenjenim istraživačima crnačke i queer tematike, ovaj dokumentarac otkriva kako je Richard izražavanje vlastite osobnosti pretvorio u umjetnost, a da pritom sebi nije mogao pružiti ono što je davao svijetu. Tijekom svog života Richard je poput sjajne, a napukle kuglice flipera poskakivao između Boga, seksa i rock 'n' rolla. Svijet ga je pokušavao ugurati u određene okvire, no Richard je bio sveprisutno biće koje je u sebi sadržavalo mnogošto - i on je bez stida bio sve.

programme.title: Agent sreće
programme.desc: Dokumentarna ekipa prati dva agenta za sreću u četrdesetim godinama koji dva puta godišnje provode mjesec i pol dana na putu, obilazeći od vrata do vrata s upitnicima u izoliranim selima Himalaje. Autori filma nastoje pružiti intiman uvid u svakodnevni život i želje ljudi u Butanu, ali i potražiti odgovor na univerzalno pitanje može li se sreća doista mjeriti. Agent sreće obećava dirljivo putovanje u tajanstveni, bajkoviti svijet, koji je potpuna suprotnost društvenom poretku kojim dominiraju potrošnja i želje.

programme.title: Dora - bijeg u glazbu
programme.desc: Svojim dokumentarnim filmom, koncipiranim u formi potrage za minulim vremenom, autori Kyra Steckeweh i Tim Van Beveren u fokus stavljaju upečatljivu ulogu jedinstvene žene i umjetnice, kakva je bila Dora Pejačević, u kontekstu europske kulturne povijesti. U rodnoj Hrvatskoj skladateljica Dora Pejačević (1885.-1923.) poznata je poput Mozarta. Svaki hrvatski školarac upoznat je s njezinim imenom i prezimenom, pa opet, u ostatku Europe ova velika umjetnica gotovo je nepoznata. Za života su joj djela izvođena u Dresdenu, Budimpešti, Beču i mnogim drugim europskim gradovima. Ipak, nakon što je umrla u Münchenu 1923., Pejačević pada u zaborav, a njezino ime nestaje s koncertnih programa. Sudbina je to koju Pejačević, u povijesti glazbe, dijeli s mnogim drugim skladateljicama. Ipak, njezina je glazba vrlo živo, uzbudljivo glazbeno iskustvo čak i danas.

programme.title: Talijanska kuhinja osvaja Ameriku
programme.desc: Gastronomska kultura rezultat je putovanja ljudi u potrazi za novim jelima. Najbolji dokaz za to je talijanska hrana koja je za vrijeme velkikih migracija putovala u Ameriku. Gotovo stotinu godina kasnije, ovaj dokumentarac prati korake hrane i njezino putovanje u New York i Buenos Aires i pronalazi osnove nove tradicije, talijanske hrane u emigraciji. Kakva je povezanost hrane u New Yorku s Italijom?Možemo li govoriti o talijanskoj hrani izvan Italije? Kroz iskaze brojnih ljudi diljem svijeta otkrivamo kako se talijanska hrana adaptirala diljem svijeta.
